children: traded higher on Thursday after Stifel launched its coverage of the breast implant maker with a Buy rating and an $84 target, citing better-than-expected growth prospects in the breast augmentation market.

Referring to a survey of 66 U.S. plastic surgeons, analyst Joseph Federico said that 74% of respondents expected the market to grow over the next three years compared with 25% and 2% who projected it to remain unchanged or decline, respectively.
Additionally, the respondents anticipate Establishment Labs
to gain market share over the next two years and its minimally invasive product portfolio to expand the overall breast augmentation market, aiding its uptake among a large group of surgeons.

Noting that ESTA currently trades below 6x in terms of 2027E sales, with roughly a 1.5x premium to its three-year average, the analyst cites further upside given Street and Stifel’s “potentially conservative” revenue estimates and the company’s improved profitability profile.

title: Establishment Labs a new Buy at Stifel on end-market prospects
